title: Constant complexes under normalized finite coefficient transport
statement: Let S be a scheme, ell prime, E/Q_ell finite, d an adic datum on O_E with ideal generated by the recorded uniformizer, c an IntegralResidueCoefficientModel on S, and n a natural number. For every cochain complex B over the small ring O_E/d.ideal^(n+1), realize its integralResidueQuotientLift as a constant finite coefficient complex on S and apply integralResidueFiniteModel. This object is isomorphic globally on S to completedAdicDerivedChange along residueLisseConstantComparison applied to residueLisseDerivedConstant of Q(B). No chart, morphism of schemes or perfectness hypothesis is imposed. Here the supplied model is [lem-weil-pbc-integral-residue-coefficient-model], the finite transport is [lem-weil-pbc-integral-residue-finite-reduction], the module lift is [def-weil-pbc-integral-residue-quotient-lift], and the residue constant functor and comparison are [lem-weil-pbc-residue-lisse-perfect-lift].

proof.text: Define finiteTransport by the same three coefficient isomorphisms as integralResidueFiniteModel. Cancel finiteRingComparison and pbcLevelConstantComparison using constantLargeIso_scalars. Naturality of constant ring sheafification transports integralCoefficientULift on quotient representatives, and c.finite_constants gives the small quotient constant. integralResidueQuotientEquiv_mk and residueLisseConstantComparison_apply identify the other side. Quotient surjectivity proves the resulting scalar-square equality on all sections of the constant presheaf.

proof.text: For a locally bijective scalar presentation, the proved constantComparisonHom identifies constant module sheafification after restriction to constants. Its naturality follows from the module sheafification adjunction unit. Restrict the sheafification adjunction along the fully faithful constant-module embedding; the associated-module realization is an equivalence. Cancel its fully faithful constant-scalar restriction to identify ordinary constants followed by associated-module realization with constant-module sheafification. Apply pbcAssociatedRestriction_exists to the scalar square, and constantCommuteCompose to restriction along the quotient ring equivalence. Cancel the coefficient ring isomorphism and combine the two algebraic scalar restrictions. This constructs ordinaryConstants, a natural isomorphism of the actual two ordinary functors.

source.place: Section 6.5, Lemma 6.5.8(1),(2), and Proposition 6.6.11; normalized coefficient presentations and localization of ringed sites.

proof.text: Derived restriction along a ring-sheaf isomorphism is an equivalence. Its inverse is restriction along the inverse map, by the restriction round-trip comparison. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies completedAdicDerivedChange with this inverse. Apply ordinaryConstants degreewise to B; naturality in each differential makes it an isomorphism of complexes. Localize it, use the exact functor factorization isomorphisms, and conjugate with DerivedCategory.Q.objObjPreimageIso to remove the representative in integralResidueFiniteModel. These operations yield the asserted Nonempty isomorphism without boundedness, perfectness or nonemptiness assumptions.

from.place: The integral-lattice step: normalize finite constant models on each stratum; identify the two global constant coefficient realizations.

lean.statement:
theorem integralResidueFiniteConstants
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (hd : d.ideal = Ideal.span {Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E})
    (c : IntegralResidueCoefficientModel l E d S) (n : ℕ)
    (B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u}
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))) ℤ) :
    Nonempty
      (integralResidueFiniteModel S l E d c n
          ((finiteCoefficientRealization S
            (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
                (((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology S)
                    (ModuleCat.{u + 1}
                      (PbcQuotient (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
                    (((integralResidueQuotientLift l E d hd n).mapHomologicalComplex
                      (.up ℤ)).obj B)))) ≅
        (completedAdicDerivedChange S (residueLisseConstantComparison S d n)).obj
          ((residueLisseDerivedConstant S
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj B)))
